reason: The submission establishes at most a plausible 129 A^3 indexing pseudocell, not the exact P-1 structure. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied and the trajectory never performed a whole-profile/Rietveld refinement; its retained model was selected with an ad hoc integrated-reflection objective plus a geometry penalty. The calculated intensities remain materially wrong, including predicted peaks near 13.92, 46.12-46.43, 48.0-48.17, 50.15-51.06, and 54.75-54.87 degrees that are absent or very weak, while major observed intensity around 35.1, 47.65, 52.5, and numerous peaks above 60 degrees is badly underfit. The coordinates are also physically doubtful (about 2.48 A Ca-Ca, 2.59 A Ca-Co, and 2.44 A Co-O despite formal Co(VI)). Most importantly, the trace identified but did not instantiate and rigorously compare a chemically motivated 1543.8 A^3 orthorhombic, Z=12 cell that indexed 24/26 input lines versus 22/26 for the selected pseudocell, and it found multiple materially distinct P-1/P1 realizations, including a lower diffraction-objective P1 solution. Thus Z, symmetry, coordinates, and ordering remain unresolved, and another solution attempt is warranted.
